neighbours.label: the letters 'est' ending a short word-piece of the form consonant(s) + 'est' (fest, vest, nest, zest, jest, pest, chest), in any language or sense, including when such a piece starts a longer word (Oktoberfest, vestige, Nestlé); NOT a/i/o + 'st' (fast, mist, cost), not 'est' inside a longer single token (street, estate, Budapest), and weak on the very common words test, rest, best, west
fire: The town holds a summer music fest every July by the lake.
He wore a wool vest under his jacket to stay warm.
A robin built a nest in the gutter above our door.
Add a little lemon zest to brighten the sauce.
She said it only in jest, but he took it seriously.
Aphids are a common garden pest in early spring.
The pirates buried a wooden chest full of coins.
We flew to Munich just to visit Oktoberfest.
quiet: The town holds a summer music festival... no, a summer concert every July by the lake.
He wore a wool sweater under his jacket to stay warm.
A robin built its home in the gutter above our door.
Add a little lemon juice to brighten the sauce.
She said it only as a joke, but he took it seriously.
Aphids are a common garden nuisance in early spring.
The pirates buried a wooden box full of coins.
We flew to Budapest just to visit the thermal baths.
